title: Uni-League: Collegiate LoL Leaderboard
summary: Collegiate League of Legends leaderboard featuring dynamic email university grouping, custom profile icon verification, and a continuous scalar rank-sorting engine.
problem: Collegiate esports players lacked a unified platform to verify account ownership seamlessly and compete across university-specific and national leaderboards.
approach: I built a Flask and React application featuring custom profile icon verification challenges, dynamic domain tenant allocation, and a scalar SQL ranking engine.
outcome: Deployed a live web application providing automated collegiate tenant grouping and League of Legends leaderboard tracking.
designChoices: Custom Icon Verification: Bypassed third-party API OAuth restrictions by verifying account ownership via dynamic profile icon swapping challenges.
Dynamic Domain Tenant Allocation: Automatically extracted university identifiers from verified emails to assign users to global and school leaderboards.
Linearized Rank Ranking Engine: Mapped non-alphabetical game tiers and LP into a unified numeric score for accurate leaderboard sorting in SQL.
UI & Feature Overhaul: Modernized the original Flask/React application architecture by integrating a friend network system and enhanced UI.
